RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: Cannot responsibly estimate a number from these facts.

An all-women panel is not, by itself, evidence of sex bias. Your qualifications warrant a clear explanation, but the announcement may omit relevant experience, and leadership or consultation skills may have carried substantial weight.

Follow up on your written request. Ask for the selection criteria, their weighting, feedback on your assessment, and any available review procedure. Focus on whether the advertised requirements were applied consistently—not the panel’s sex.

If evidence emerges of sex-based remarks, inconsistent standards, or departures from mandatory qualifications, raise those specific concerns. Check local complaint deadlines now; waiting for a response may not pause them.
